einzeiler: Mike and Michele Seamons on questioning Mormonism and shifting family beliefs
kurzfassung: Mike and Michele Seamons discuss their family's evolving relationship with the LDS church as their children face challenges with missions and faith. They describe stepping outside the Mormon community, exploring other Christian traditions, and engaging with external media. Their journey prompts deeper questions about religious authority, spiritual experiences, and finding meaning outside of Mormonism.
stichpunkte: Children struggling with missions and their place in the church
Mike attempting to work with church leadership regarding youth retention
Stepping outside the Mormon community and exploring other Christian traditions
Consuming media not run by the LDS church, including the LDS Discussions podcast
Questioning religious authority, faith, family, and spiritual experiences
Distinguishing between feeling the spirit and experiencing human awe or wonder
Focusing on exploration, connection, and helping others navigate changing beliefs
beschreibung:
In Part Three of Mike and Michele’s story, the couple begins confronting serious concerns about Mormonism as their children struggle with missions, faith, and their place in the church. Mike becomes increasingly concerned about the challenges young Mormons are facing, and struggles to work with church leadership to keep them engaged in their faith.

As they discover that the church is not working for their family in the same way anymore, they begin stepping further outside the Mormon community. They explore other Christian traditions and begin to consume media not run by the LDS church, such as the LDS Discussions podcast.

Their journey raises difficult questions about authority, faith, family, and whether personal spiritual experiences can be trusted. They begin to question the difference between feeling “the Spirit” and experiencing awe or wonder simply as part of the human condition. In search of these answers, they find themselves searching for meaning outside of Mormonism.

Today, Mike and Michele are focused less on having all the answers and more on exploration, connection, and helping others navigate the questions that come with changing beliefs. We hope that their story can be helpful to your search for wonder, as well!
